templates.label: Booking thanks
templates.body: Hi {first}, thanks for booking with Oasis Auto Spa.

templates.label: Confirmation request
templates.body: Your appointment at Oasis Auto Spa is confirmed for {time}. Reply C to confirm.

templates.label: Confirmed
templates.body: Your appointment is confirmed for {time}.

templates.label: Reminder
templates.body: Reminder: your Oasis Auto Spa appointment is {when} at {time}.

templates.label: Welcome
templates.body: Welcome to Oasis! You’re checked in{#bay} — pull into Bay {bay}{/bay}.

templates.label: In progress
templates.body: Good news — your vehicle is now being cleaned.

templates.label: Ready for pickup
templates.body: Your vehicle is ready for pickup!

templates.label: Receipt
templates.body: Payment received — receipt sent. Thank you!

templates.label: Reschedule
templates.body: Your appointment has been moved to {time}. Reply if that doesn’t work.

templates.label: Review request
templates.body: Thanks for visiting Oasis Auto Spa! How did we do? ⭐

templates.label: Late nudge
templates.body: Hi {first}, we’re holding your {time} appointment at Oasis Auto Spa. Running late? Reply and let us know.

templates.label: Payment link
templates.body: Here is your secure payment link: {link}

templates.label: Closure notice
templates.body: Hi {first}, Oasis Auto Spa will be closed {until}. We’re sorry for the inconvenience.{#link} Pick a new time here: {link}{/link}

templates.label: Emergency closing
templates.body: Hi {first}, due to {reason} Oasis Auto Spa is closed {until}. We’re sorry for the inconvenience. Pick a new time here: {link}

templates.label: Staff invite
templates.body: Hi {first}, you’re invited to the Oasis Auto Spa team. Set up your login here: {link}

templates.label: Password reset
templates.body: Hi {first}, here is your Oasis Auto Spa password reset link: {link} It works once and expires soon. If you did not ask for it, ignore this text.

templates.label: Add-on approval
templates.body: We recommend {addon} ({price}) for your vehicle. Would you like to approve it? Reply here and we’ll add it.

templates.label: Opt-out confirmation
templates.body: You’re unsubscribed from Oasis Auto Spa texts and won’t get any more. Reply START to subscribe again.

templates.label: Opt-in confirmation
templates.body: You’re subscribed to Oasis Auto Spa texts again. Reply STOP to opt out.

templates.label: Help reply
templates.body: Oasis Auto Spa: reply here and our team will get back to you{#phone}, or call {phone}{/phone}. Msg frequency varies. Reply STOP to opt out.

templates.label: Confirmation acknowledged
templates.body: Thanks! Your appointment is confirmed for {time}. See you then.

templates.label: Nothing to confirm
templates.body: We don’t have an appointment waiting for confirmation. Reply here if you need a hand.
